laws.rule: Parque Nacional Río Clarillo: The Arboretum trail is specifically closed from 9 to 13 November 2026 inclusive for scientific work. Rincón de los Bueyes, Aliwén Mahuida and Peumal are closed until further notice after removal of river footbridges. The dated Arboretum closure should not be overridden by its inclusion in a separate generic available-trails list. The named unit prohibits fires and other heat sources, pets or exotic animals, leaving enabled trails and removing natural resources. Follow ranger instructions; no region-wide extension is made.

items.text: Parque Nacional Río Clarillo: CONAF's own unit page prohibits consuming alcoholic drinks. This is the named protected-area condition, not an alcohol ban throughout the region.

Parque Nacional Río Clarillo: smoking is prohibited in CONAF's published unit conditions. The same page prohibits consuming drugs or hallucinogenic products; no wider possession or prescribing rule is inferred.
